'''2020 TMW Pods Grady Hutchins DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Grady Hutchins]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Grady Hutchins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Deal Is Getting Worse A Hutchi.txt |Download]]
